game.name: Stormrise (Germany)
game.desc: Stormrise is a real-time strategy game for Xbox 360. The story takes place in a post-apocalyptic future, when the Earth has been devastated by a cataclysm. Now a desert, the planet is in the grip of a conflict between two surviving factions: the Echelon, a technologically advanced people, and the Sai, more tribal but well adapted to their new environment. The game features an atypical control system and maps that emphasise the notion of overhang.
